description: This file defines a custom select dropdown component built using React and Radix UI primitives, integrating iconography and utility functions for styling. It encapsulates the construction of a stylized, accessible select component with various subcomponents such as trigger, content, items, labels, separators, and scroll buttons.

methods.name: React.forwardRef
methods.description: Creates a React component with a forwarded ref, used here to define custom components that wrap Radix UI primitives with additional styling and structure.
